\[
H(x,y) = -\sum_{v=0}^{255} p_{xy}(v) \log_2 p_{xy}(v)
\]

The formula shows the default parameter values.

where

- \(p_{xy}(v)\): Share of the window with value v

p_xy(v) is the share of the window with the whole value v. Terms with p = 0 count as 0. A flat window has entropy 0. A window whose n values are all different has the largest entropy, log2 n bits. The measure counts how many different values occur and how evenly, not where they are.
